title: Pure Megalith
summary: The pure Megalith EARTH Rock Ritual build with the 2025 support (Megalith Anastasis, Megalith Notrah Plura, and Megalith Phuloch) and generic staples. Instead of using traditional Ritual Spells, the Megalith monsters Ritual Summon each other directly through their own hand and field effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Megalith Anastasis discards a card to search one Level 4 or lower Megalith and one Level 8 Megalith from the Deck.
Megalith Ophiel searches a Megalith monster when Ritual Summoned, while Megalith Hagith searches a Megalith Spell or Trap.
Megalith Unformed Tributes monsters whose total Levels equal twice a Megalith's Level to Ritual Summon a Level 4 Megalith like Megalith Phul directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Anastasis or Unformed into Phul & Phuloch
steps: Activate Megalith Anastasis and discard a card to search Level 4 Megalith Ophiel and Level 8 Megalith Phaleg (or Megalith Bethor).
Discard Phaleg to Ritual Summon Ophiel; Ophiel searches Level 2 Megalith Phul while Anastasis draws 2 cards and discards 1.
Use Ophiel on the field to Ritual Summon Megalith Phul, which copies Ophiel's Level and recovers Phaleg from the GY.
Ritual Summon Megalith Phuloch to recover another Megalith card from the GY and set up Quick Effect Ritual Summons on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spell-less Ritual Mechanics
summary.text: The Level 8 Megaliths (Phaleg, Bethor, and Aratron) discard themselves from the hand to Ritual Summon any Megalith from your hand, while the Level 4s (Ophiel, Hagith, Och) and Level 2 Phul Ritual Summon from the hand, Deck, or GY while on the field. Megalith Anastasis rewards you once per turn when you Ritual Summon a Level 8 Megalith (by making the opponent Tribute a monster) and when you Ritual Summon a Level 4 or lower Megalith (by drawing 2 and discarding 1).

summary.title: Opponent's-Turn Disruption & Payoff
points: Megalith Phul Ritual Summons a Megalith monster directly from the hand or Deck as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase—most notably summoning Megalith Bethor to destroy opposing cards up to the number of Ritual Monster names in your GY.
Megalith Phuloch Ritual Summons a Megalith from your GY during either Main Phase, while Megalith Och and Megalith Aratron also Ritual Summon at Quick Effect speed.
Megalith Notrah Plura reveals itself in the hand so the opponent cannot respond to your Megalith Ritual Monster activations, and negates and destroys an opponent's card activation while on the field.
Megalith Phaleg boosts all monsters you control by 300 ATK and DEF for every Ritual Monster in your GY to close out games.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Megalith Portal prevents Ritual Summoned monsters from being destroyed by battle once per turn and recovers a Ritual Monster from the GY whenever a Megalith is Special Summoned.
Megalith Emergence revives a Megalith monster from your GY in Defense Position once per turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Impcantation, Drytron, and Herald engines are left out to keep the build pure Megalith.
